title: Refined defect-cavity with targeted initialization and mirror penalties
scientific_hypothesis: Initializing central defect layers (13-16) to half-wave optical thickness at 1550 nm and tightening their optimizer step size, while penalizing mirror layer deviation from quarter-wave thickness, will improve transmission peak convergence and visible stopband sharpness compared to route_03.
design_principle: Distributed Bragg Reflector (DBR) mirrors surrounding a half-wave defect cavity to create a transmission passband within a high-reflection stopband.
proposed_topology: 30-layer finite stack. Air incidence. Layers 1-12: Alternating HfO2/SiO2 Bragg Mirror. Layers 13-16: Defect Cavity (initialized half-wave @ 1550 nm). Layers 17-30: Alternating HfO2/SiO2 Bragg Mirror. Substrate: Fused Silica.
design_variables: optimizer step size scaling for layers 13-16
penalty weight for mirror layer deviation
soft_objectives: Minimize deviation from quarter-wave optical thickness for mirror layers
theory_basis: Transfer Matrix Method for stratified media
Quarter-wave stack theory for high reflection
Half-wave defect theory for transmission resonance
expected_advantages: Improved convergence of the transmission resonance peak
known_risks: Over-constraining mirror layers may limit global optimum search
Numerical convergence issues may persist if step size is too small
execution_request_english: Execute a Transfer Matrix Method optimization for a 30-layer planar dielectric stack on a Fused Silica substrate with Air incidence. Materials: Alternating HfO2 and SiO2 (Layer 1 = HfO2). Wavelength bands: 400-700 nm (Target: High Reflectance), 1530-1565 nm (Target: High Transmittance). Topology: Layers 1-12 and 17-30 are Bragg mirror layers; Layers 13-16 are defect cavity layers. Initialization: Layers 13-16 initialized to half-wave optical thickness at 1550 nm (d = 1550 / (2 * n)). Optimization Constraints: Apply a step size scaling factor of 0.5 to variables for layers 13-16. Apply an increased penalty weight in the objective function for layers 1-12 and 17-30 deviating from quarter-wave optical thickness at 550 nm. Total layer count fixed at 30. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, and thicknesses_nm. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1530–1565 nm; high reflection in 400–700 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1530–1565 nm; transmission in 400–700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 30.
revision_reason: Implementing feedback directives to target cavity layers 13-16 with specific initialization and step size, and increasing mirror penalty weights to sharpen stopband.
